Story.title: Story
Story.description: An interactive adventure story definition configured by an admin.

title.description: Display title of the adventure story.

description.description: Short synopsis shown on the Netflix-style story card.

systemPrompt.description: System instruction prompt guiding Gemini for this story's world and rules.

coverImage.description: Cover image URL, data reference, or bundled preset key (e.g., preset:mystic_realm).

genre.description: Adventure category badge shown on the card.

openingLine.description: Initial opening narrative message when a player starts the story.

isActive.description: Whether the story is active and visible to players.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the story was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the story was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated player profile storing their chosen in-game name.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

name.description: Player name entered once (e.g., Vansh) used by the AI storyteller.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

StoryChat.title: StoryChat
StoryChat.description: Isolated per-user, per-story chat session with rolling summary and message list.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

storyId.description: ID of the story being played.

storyTitle.description: Denormalized story title for admin inspection.

messages.description: List of chat message maps ({id, role, content, timestampMs, options}).

summary.description: Auto-generated memory summary updated every 20 messages.

messageCount.description: Total number of messages exchanged in this story session.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the chat session started.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last chat activity.

grantedAt.description: Timestamp when admin role was granted.

/stories/{storyId}.description: Adventure stories catalog displayed on the home screen and managed in /admin.

/users/{userId}.description: Player profiles keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/chats/{chatId}.description: Per-user per-story isolated chat histories keyed by {userId}_{storyId}.
